source.description: Hand-written fixture for the Argus example product. Entirely fictional; no real trails, places, or organizations.

collection.title: Example Field Guide
collection.description: A small static field guide used to demonstrate the Argus spine end to end. Groups are regions; slots are individual guide entries.
authoring_rules: Each slot is one self-contained guide entry.
Entries within a group are ordered and read as a sequence.
A slot advances through planned -> outlined -> seeded as it gains substance.

status_vocabulary.planned: Slot reserved in the catalog; no content drafted.
status_vocabulary.outlined: Structure and intent recorded; body not written.
status_vocabulary.seeded: A usable first version exists on disk.

groups.title: Coast Path
groups.summary: Shoreline entries, ordered from the harbour outward.

groups.title: Ridge Loop
groups.summary: Upland entries forming a loop above the coast path.

groups.title: Marsh Boardwalk
groups.summary: Wetland entries; the least developed group in this fixture.
